entities.name: Healing of Zendikar
entities.description: A magical event in 4561 AR in which Nissa Revane merged the Lithoform Core with Zendikar's elemental magic, destroying the Singing City and accelerating the plane's healing.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane recovering from the ravages of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who viewed Zendikar's wildness as intrinsic and merged the Lithoform Core with her elemental connection.

entities.name: Lithoform Core
entities.description: An ancient artifact believed to contain the power to rewrite natural laws, born from Zendikar itself.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who found the Core in the Murasa Skyclave and sought to use it to stabilize Zendikar.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled to the Singing City to mediate and seized the Core with illusions.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A companion of Jace who did not enter the Singing City ruins.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's elemental companion, who returned the Core to Nissa.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: Ruins of intense leyline convergence and harmonic resonance, destroyed in the explosion.

entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: The skyclave where Nahiri discovered the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A long-lost region that began to regrow after the Healing.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose destruction left Zendikar unstable.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The battle after which the Eldrazi titans fell and Zendikar remained unstable.

events.summary: Nahiri discovers the Lithoform Core in the Murasa Skyclave and travels to the Singing City to use it.
events.quote: was discovered by Nahiri in the Murasa Skyclave

events.summary: Nahiri plans to stabilize Zendikar with the Core, but Nissa opposes her.
events.quote: Her plan was opposed by Nissa Revane

events.summary: Jace and Akiri travel to the Singing City to mediate; Jace is overcome by the resonance but escapes and finds Nissa and Ashaya.
events.quote: Jace was temporarily overcome by the ruins' song-mad cacophony

events.summary: Nissa destroys the leyline focal point Nahiri intended to use; conflict escalates and Jace seizes the Core with illusions before Ashaya returns it to Nissa.
events.quote: Ashaya intervened and returned the Core to Nissa.

events.summary: The Core reveals it was born from Zendikar, and Nissa merges it with her elemental connection, channeling its power through herself and Ashaya.
events.quote: Nissa allowed the Core to merge with her elemental connection

events.summary: The explosion obliterates the Singing City and is followed by a surge of regrowth that revives regions like Bala Ged.
events.quote: The resulting explosion obliterated the Singing City

events.summary: Nissa discards the inert Core and departs; Nahiri, furious, planeswalks away; Jace stays to witness the recovery.
events.quote: Nahiri, furious at her failure and Jace's perceived betrayal, planeswalked away.

relations.note: opposed Nahiri's plan for the Core
relations.quote: Her plan was opposed by Nissa Revane
Nissa and her elemental companion, Ashaya

relations.note: traveled to the Singing City together
relations.quote: Jace Beleren and Akiri also traveled to the Singing City
